scene.primarySubject: A small child walking at the front, one hand loosely guiding a wolf and a lamb beside them
scene.action: The wolf and lamb walk together calmly without threat, led by the child along the path
scene.setting: Terraced hillside fields with low stone walls under a clear, hazy sky in Judah
scene.secondaryElements: A young leopard resting nearby and a young goat grazing near the wall; the distant walled city gate faint on the horizon
scene.mood: Peaceful, tender and hopeful, with quiet dignity
scene.timeOfDay: Late afternoon shifting toward evening, clear still air after a dry spell
scene.composition: Medium-wide view from slightly below the path, the child and animals in the foreground, hills receding behind

packet.verseText: Above him stood the seraphim. Each one had six wings. With two he covered his face. With two he covered his feet. With two he flew.

availableCast.name: God / Yahweh, the Father and God of Israel

scene.primarySubject: Isaiah in plain linen, kneeling and looking upward; winged seraphim hovering above him with faces veiled
scene.action: Six-winged seraphim hover in the air, covering faces and feet with wings while others beat their wings in flight
scene.setting: High stone sanctuary of the temple in Jerusalem, raised altar and carved cedar walls
scene.secondaryElements: Bronze lamp stands at the lower walls, dense incense smoke, radiance and glowing cloud spread across the upper space above the altar
scene.mood: Awe, reverence and trembling humility
scene.timeOfDay: Early morning, pale gold light from high openings, still air
scene.composition: Low viewpoint from the temple floor looking up, Isaiah in the lower foreground, seraphim arrayed in the upper space within the glowing cloud
